id-20261013-news-3.title: October 13 Disaster Risk Reduction Day: How Ready Is Early Warning in Indonesia?

segments.src: Setiap 13 Oktober, dunia memperingati **Hari Internasional Pengurangan Risiko Bencana**.
segments.tr: Every October 13, the world commemorates the **International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction**.

segments.src: Peringatan ini mengingatkan bahwa korban bencana bukan semata ditentukan oleh besarnya guncangan atau derasnya hujan, melainkan oleh seberapa siap masyarakat dan pemerintah sebelum bencana datang.
segments.tr: This observance reminds us that disaster casualties are not determined solely by the magnitude of the shock or the heaviness of the rain, but by how prepared the community and government are before a disaster strikes.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, pesan ini sangat relevan.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, this message is highly relevant.

segments.src: ## Hidup di Jalur Cincin Api
segments.tr: ## Living on the Ring of Fire

segments.src: Indonesia terletak di pertemuan beberapa lempeng tektonik besar dan berada di jalur Cincin Api Pasifik.
segments.tr: Indonesia is located at the confluence of several major tectonic plates and lies along the Pacific Ring of Fire.

segments.src: Kondisi geologis ini membuat gempa bumi, tsunami, dan letusan gunung api menjadi bagian dari kenyataan geografis.
segments.tr: This geological condition makes earthquakes, tsunamis, and volcanic eruptions part of the geographical reality.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, curah hujan tinggi, perubahan tata guna lahan, serta alur sungai yang menyempit membuat banjir dan tanah longsor terjadi hampir setiap musim hujan.
segments.tr: On the other hand, high rainfall, changes in land use, and narrowing river channels cause floods and landslides to occur almost every rainy season.

segments.src: Bencana alam tidak bisa dicegah, tetapi dampaknya bisa ditekan.
segments.tr: Natural disasters cannot be prevented, but their impacts can be mitigated.

segments.src: Di sinilah peringatan dini dan kesiapsiagaan berperan: memberi waktu bagi warga untuk menyelamatkan diri, dan memberi pedoman tindakan yang jelas ketika waktu itu sangat singkat.
segments.tr: This is where early warning and preparedness play a role: giving residents time to save themselves, and providing clear action guidelines when time is very short.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Sudah Ada
segments.tr: ## What Already Exists

segments.src: Dalam dua dekade terakhir, Indonesia membangun sejumlah fondasi penting.
segments.tr: Over the past two decades, Indonesia has built several important foundations.

segments.src: - **Sistem peringatan dini tsunami.** Setelah tsunami Aceh 2004, Indonesia mengembangkan sistem peringatan dini tsunami nasional (InaTEWS) yang dikelola Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika (BMKG). BMKG kini mampu menerbitkan informasi gempa dan potensi tsunami dalam hitungan menit setelah kejadian.
segments.tr: - **Tsunami early warning system.** Following the 2004 Aceh tsunami, Indonesia developed the national tsunami early warning system (InaTEWS) managed by the Agency for Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics (BMKG). BMKG is now able to issue earthquake and potential tsunami information within minutes of an event.

segments.src: - **Informasi cuaca dan iklim.** BMKG secara rutin merilis peringatan dini cuaca ekstrem, termasuk potensi hujan lebat, angin kencang, dan gelombang tinggi, melalui situs, aplikasi, dan media sosial resmi.
segments.tr: - **Weather and climate information.** BMKG routinely releases early warnings for extreme weather, including the potential for heavy rain, strong winds, and high waves, through official websites, apps, and social media.

segments.src: - **Pemetaan risiko.** Badan Nasional Penanggulangan Bencana (BNPB) menyediakan platform InaRISK yang memungkinkan warga melihat tingkat ancaman bencana di wilayah masing-masing.
segments.tr: - **Risk mapping.** The National Disaster Management Authority (BNPB) provides the InaRISK platform, which allows residents to see the level of disaster threat in their respective regions.

segments.src: - **Pemantauan gunung api dan gerakan tanah.** Badan Geologi memantau aktivitas gunung api dan memberikan peta zona kerentanan gerakan tanah sebagai acuan daerah.
segments.tr: - **Volcano and ground movement monitoring.** The Geological Agency monitors volcanic activity and provides regional reference maps of ground movement vulnerability zones.

segments.src: - **Program berbasis komunitas.** Program seperti Desa Tangguh Bencana (Destana) dan Satuan Pendidikan Aman Bencana (SPAB) mendorong warga dan sekolah menyusun rencana evakuasi, jalur aman, serta titik kumpul.
segments.tr: - **Community-based programs.** Programs such as Disaster-Resilient Villages (Destana) and Disaster-Safe Education Units (SPAB) encourage residents and schools to formulate evacuation plans, safe routes, and assembly points.

segments.src: - **Latihan rutin.** Gerakan seperti Hari Kesiapsiagaan Bencana setiap 26 April mendorong simulasi serentak di berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: - **Routine drills.** Movements like Disaster Preparedness Day on April 26 encourage simultaneous simulations in various regions.

segments.src: ## Celah yang Masih Perlu Dibenahi
segments.tr: ## Gaps That Still Need Fixing

segments.src: Meski kerangka sudah terbentuk, pengalaman berbagai kejadian menunjukkan masih ada pekerjaan rumah.
segments.tr: Although the framework has been established, experience from various incidents shows there is still homework to be done.

segments.src: ### 1. Rantai peringatan terakhir (last mile)
segments.tr: ### 1. The last-mile warning chain

segments.src: Peringatan yang akurat tidak berarti apa-apa jika tidak sampai ke warga yang paling terdampak.
segments.tr: An accurate warning means nothing if it does not reach the most affected residents.

segments.src: Tantangan terbesar sering berada di "kilometer terakhir": sirene yang tidak berfungsi atau tidak terdengar, sinyal telekomunikasi yang terputus saat bencana, atau pesan yang tidak dipahami karena bahasa teknis.
segments.tr: The biggest challenge often lies in the "last mile": sirens that do not function or cannot be heard, telecommunication signals that cut out during a disaster, or messages that are not understood due to technical language.

segments.src: Sistem yang bergantung pada satu kanal saja rentan gagal.
segments.tr: Systems that rely on a single channel are vulnerable to failure.

segments.src: ### 2. Perawatan peralatan dan anggaran daerah
segments.tr: ### 2. Equipment maintenance and regional budgets

segments.src: Alat pemantau, sensor, dan sirene memerlukan biaya perawatan yang berkelanjutan.
segments.tr: Monitoring tools, sensors, and sirens require sustainable maintenance costs.

segments.src: Banyak daerah menghadapi keterbatasan anggaran untuk pemeliharaan dan penggantian perangkat.
segments.tr: Many regions face budget constraints for equipment maintenance and replacement.

segments.src: Kesiapsiagaan sering kali dianggap sebagai pengeluaran yang tidak mendesak sampai bencana benar-benar terjadi.
segments.tr: Preparedness is often considered an unnecessary expense until a disaster actually strikes.

segments.src: ### 3. Peringatan dini untuk banjir dan longsor
segments.tr: ### 3. Early warning for floods and landslides

segments.src: Tsunami memiliki sistem nasional yang relatif terpusat.
segments.tr: Tsunamis have a relatively centralized national system.

segments.src: Untuk banjir bandang dan longsor, peringatan dini umumnya bersifat lokal: sensor curah hujan, alat pemantau pergerakan tanah, atau pengamatan warga.
segments.tr: For flash floods and landslides, early warnings are generally local: rainfall sensors, ground movement monitoring tools, or citizen observations.

segments.src: Cakupan perangkat ini belum merata, padahal kedua jenis bencana tersebut termasuk yang paling sering terjadi.
segments.tr: The coverage of these devices is not yet evenly distributed, even though both types of disasters are among the most frequent.

segments.src: ### 4. Latihan evakuasi yang belum menjadi kebiasaan
segments.tr: ### 4. Evacuation drills that have not become a habit

segments.src: Simulasi sering berhenti sebagai acara seremonial tahunan.
segments.tr: Simulations often stop as annual ceremonial events.

segments.src: Padahal latihan yang efektif perlu diulang, melibatkan kelompok rentan seperti lansia, penyandang disabilitas, ibu hamil, dan anak-anak, serta diuji pada berbagai skenario, termasuk malam hari atau saat listrik padam.
segments.tr: In fact, effective drills need to be repeated, involve vulnerable groups such as the elderly, people with disabilities, pregnant women, and children, and be tested under various scenarios, including at night or during a power outage.

segments.src: ### 5. Tata ruang dan jalur evakuasi
segments.tr: ### 5. Spatial planning and evacuation routes

segments.src: Rambu evakuasi, jalur yang tidak terhalang, dan bangunan evakuasi vertikal di kawasan pesisir hanya efektif jika direncanakan bersama tata ruang.
segments.tr: Evacuation signs, unobstructed routes, and vertical evacuation buildings in coastal areas are only effective if planned together with spatial layout.

segments.src: Permukiman yang terus tumbuh di kawasan rawan membuat jalur evakuasi yang sudah ada menjadi kurang memadai.
segments.tr: Continuous settlement growth in hazard-prone areas makes existing evacuation routes inadequate.

segments.src: ## Peran Pemerintah Daerah
segments.tr: ## The Role of Local Governments

segments.src: Dalam sistem penanggulangan bencana Indonesia, pemerintah daerah memegang peran sentral karena merekalah yang pertama kali menangani situasi di lapangan.
segments.tr: In Indonesia's disaster management system, local governments hold a central role because they are the first to handle situations in the field.

segments.src: Beberapa langkah yang dinilai penting:
segments.tr: Several steps considered important:

segments.src: 1. **Memasukkan pengurangan risiko bencana ke dalam perencanaan pembangunan dan tata ruang**, bukan hanya anggaran tanggap darurat.
segments.tr: 1. **Integrating disaster risk reduction into development and spatial planning**, not just emergency response budgets.

segments.src: 2. **Menjamin perawatan** sirene, sensor, dan sistem komunikasi, termasuk jalur cadangan seperti radio komunitas dan radio panggil.
segments.tr: 2. **Ensuring the maintenance** of sirens, sensors, and communication systems, including backup routes such as community radio and pagers.

segments.src: 3. **Menyusun dan memperbarui rencana kontingensi** serta jalur evakuasi bersama warga.
segments.tr: 3. **Formulating and updating contingency plans** and evacuation routes together with residents.

segments.src: 4. **Melatih relawan dan aparat desa** agar mampu meneruskan peringatan dengan bahasa yang mudah dipahami.
segments.tr: 4. **Training volunteers and village apparatus** so they can pass on warnings in easy-to-understand language.

segments.src: 5. **Memastikan kelompok rentan terlibat** dalam perencanaan dan latihan.
segments.tr: 5. **Ensuring vulnerable groups are involved** in planning and drills.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Bisa Dilakukan Warga
segments.tr: ## What Citizens Can Do

segments.src: Kesiapsiagaan bukan hanya urusan pemerintah.
segments.tr: Preparedness is not just the government's business.

segments.src: Beberapa langkah sederhana yang bisa dilakukan setiap keluarga:
segments.tr: Some simple steps every family can take:

segments.src: - **Kenali risiko lingkungan sekitar** melalui peta risiko resmi dan informasi dari pemerintah desa atau kelurahan.
segments.tr: - **Recognize surrounding environmental risks** through official risk maps and information from the village or sub-district government.

segments.src: - **Ikuti kanal resmi** seperti BMKG dan BNPB agar tidak terpapar kabar yang belum terverifikasi.
segments.tr: - **Follow official channels** such as BMKG and BNPB so as not to be exposed to unverified news.

segments.src: - **Siapkan tas siaga bencana** berisi dokumen penting, obat-obatan, senter, makanan tahan lama, dan air minum.
segments.tr: - **Prepare a disaster preparedness bag** containing important documents, medicines, a flashlight, non-perishable food, and drinking water.

segments.src: - **Sepakati titik kumpul dan jalur evakuasi** bersama anggota keluarga, termasuk rencana bagi anggota yang membutuhkan bantuan.
segments.tr: - **Agree on an assembly point and evacuation routes** with family members, including plans for members who need assistance.

segments.src: - **Ikut serta dalam simulasi** di lingkungan, sekolah, atau tempat kerja, dan jadikan latihan ini kebiasaan, bukan formalitas.
segments.tr: - **Participate in simulations** in the neighborhood, school, or workplace, and make these drills a habit, not a formality.

segments.src: - **Pahami tanda alam.** Misalnya, guncangan gempa yang kuat atau lama di wilayah pesisir adalah tanda untuk segera menuju tempat tinggi tanpa menunggu sirene.
segments.tr: - **Understand natural signs.** For example, strong or prolonged earthquake shaking in coastal areas is a sign to immediately head to high ground without waiting for a siren.

segments.src: ## Menuju Peringatan Dini untuk Semua
segments.tr: ## Toward Early Warning for All

segments.src: Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa telah mendorong inisiatif agar seluruh penduduk dunia terlindungi oleh sistem peringatan dini dalam beberapa tahun ke depan.
segments.tr: The United Nations has pushed for an initiative so that the entire world population is protected by early warning systems in the coming years.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, tujuan ini berarti memperkuat empat hal sekaligus: pemahaman risiko, pemantauan dan peramalan, penyebaran peringatan, serta kemampuan masyarakat untuk bertindak.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, this goal means strengthening four things at once: risk understanding, monitoring and forecasting, warning dissemination, and the community's capacity to act.

segments.src: Hari Pengurangan Risiko Bencana menjadi pengingat bahwa investasi pada kesiapsiagaan adalah investasi pada keselamatan.
segments.tr: Disaster Risk Reduction Day serves as a reminder that investment in preparedness is an investment in safety.

segments.src: Teknologi yang canggih akan bernilai penuh bila peringatan sampai tepat waktu, dipahami, dan dilanjutkan dengan tindakan nyata oleh warga yang sudah terbiasa berlatih.
segments.tr: Advanced technology will achieve its full value if warnings arrive on time, are understood, and are followed by real action from residents who are used to practicing.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is for general information purposes.

segments.src: Untuk informasi kebencanaan terkini, rujuklah selalu pengumuman resmi BMKG, BNPB, dan pemerintah daerah setempat.*
segments.tr: For the latest disaster information, always refer to official announcements from BMKG, BNPB, and local governments.*

id-20261013-news-1.title: October 17th International Day for the Eradication of Poverty: How to Read BPS Poverty Statistics and Understand Vulnerable Classes

segments.src: Setiap 17 Oktober, dunia memperingati Hari Pengentasan Kemiskinan Internasional.
segments.tr: Every October 17, the world commemorates the International Day for the Eradication of Poverty.

segments.src: Di Indonesia, momen ini biasanya diwarnai kutipan angka persentase penduduk miskin dari Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS).
segments.tr: In Indonesia, this moment is usually marked by citations of poverty percentage figures from the Central Statistics Agency (BPS).

segments.src: Angka tersebut penting, tetapi sering dibaca terlalu sederhana.
segments.tr: These figures are important, but they are often read too simply.

segments.src: Artikel ini membantu Anda memahami apa yang sebenarnya diukur oleh data resmi, apa yang tidak tertangkap olehnya, dan mengapa banyak keluarga yang secara statistik "tidak miskin" tetap berada di posisi rapuh ketika terjadi pemutusan hubungan kerja (PHK) atau harga pangan naik.
segments.tr: This article helps you understand what official data actually measures, what it misses, and why many families who are statistically "not poor" remain in a fragile position when layoffs occur or food prices rise.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Diukur oleh Garis Kemiskinan BPS
segments.tr: ## What the BPS Poverty Line Measures

segments.src: BPS menggunakan pendekatan *kebutuhan dasar* (basic needs approach).
segments.tr: BPS uses a *basic needs approach*.

segments.src: Kemiskinan dipandang sebagai ketidakmampuan memenuhi kebutuhan dasar dari sisi pengeluaran.
segments.tr: Poverty is viewed as the inability to meet basic needs in terms of expenditure.

segments.src: Garis kemiskinan terdiri dari dua komponen:
segments.tr: The poverty line consists of two components:

segments.src: - **Garis Kemiskinan Makanan (GKM):** nilai pengeluaran minimum untuk memenuhi kebutuhan energi sekitar 2.100 kilokalori per orang per hari.
segments.tr: - **Food Poverty Line (GKM):** the minimum expenditure value to meet energy needs of approximately 2,100 kilocalories per person per day.

segments.src: - **Garis Kemiskinan Non-Makanan (GKNM):** nilai minimum kebutuhan perumahan, pakaian, pendidikan, dan kesehatan.
segments.tr: - **Non-Food Poverty Line (GKNM):** the minimum value for housing, clothing, education, and health needs.

segments.src: Seseorang dikategorikan miskin jika rata-rata pengeluaran per kapita per bulan berada di bawah garis kemiskinan.
segments.tr: A person is categorized as poor if their average per capita monthly expenditure is below the poverty line.

segments.src: Data bersumber dari Survei Sosial Ekonomi Nasional (Susenas) yang dilakukan dua kali setahun, sehingga hasilnya biasanya dirilis untuk kondisi Maret dan September.
segments.tr: Data is sourced from the National Socio-Economic Survey (Susenas), which is conducted twice a year, so the results are usually released for conditions in March and September.

segments.src: Satu hal yang kerap terlewat: garis kemiskinan dinyatakan **per kapita**, sedangkan keluarga hidup sebagai **rumah tangga**.
segments.tr: One thing that is often overlooked: the poverty line is stated **per capita**, whereas families live as **households**.

segments.src: Garis kemiskinan rumah tangga adalah garis per kapita dikalikan jumlah anggota.
segments.tr: The household poverty line is the per capita line multiplied by the number of members.

segments.src: Sebuah keluarga beranggotakan empat atau lima orang memerlukan pengeluaran bulanan yang jauh lebih besar daripada angka per kapita yang tampak kecil di berita.
segments.tr: A family of four or five requires a monthly expenditure that is far greater than the seemingly small per capita figure seen in the news.

segments.src: ## Angka yang Tampak Membaik Tidak Selalu Berarti Aman
segments.tr: ## Figures That Look Better Do Not Always Mean Safe

segments.src: Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, tingkat kemiskinan nasional versi BPS bergerak di kisaran satu digit, yakni sekitar delapan persen.
segments.tr: In recent years, the national poverty rate according to BPS has moved in the single-digit range, which is around eight percent.

segments.src: Ini capaian yang patut dicatat.
segments.tr: This is a notable achievement.

segments.src: Namun, ada beberapa catatan agar angka tersebut dibaca secara proporsional:
segments.tr: However, there are several notes to ensure these figures are read proportionally:

segments.src: 1. **Garis kemiskinan adalah batas minimum, bukan ukuran kesejahteraan.** Berada sedikit di atas garis berarti tidak masuk statistik miskin, bukan berarti hidup nyaman.
segments.tr: 1. **The poverty line is a minimum threshold, not a measure of prosperity.** Being slightly above the line means not falling into poverty statistics, not living comfortably.

segments.src: 2. **Rata-rata nasional menyembunyikan variasi.** Garis kemiskinan berbeda antardaerah, dan kondisi perkotaan, perdesaan, serta antarprovinsi bisa sangat berbeda.
segments.tr: 2. **National averages hide variations.** The poverty line differs between regions, and conditions in urban, rural, and provincial areas can be very different.

segments.src: 3. **Ia adalah potret sesaat.** Susenas memotret kondisi pada periode tertentu. Rumah tangga yang jatuh ke bawah garis pada bulan-bulan setelahnya belum tentu tertangkap.
segments.tr: 3. **It is a snapshot in time.** Susenas captures conditions during a specific period. Households that fall below the line in the months after are not necessarily captured.

segments.src: 4. **Ukuran pengeluaran tidak melihat aset dan utang.** Dua keluarga dengan pengeluaran sama bisa memiliki ketahanan finansial yang berbeda jauh jika salah satunya punya tabungan dan yang lain terbelit cicilan.
segments.tr: 4. **Expenditure measures do not look at assets and debt.** Two families with the same expenditure can have vastly different financial resilience if one has savings and the other is burdened by installments.

segments.src: ## Mengenal Kelas Rentan dan Calon Kelas Menengah
segments.tr: ## Getting to Know Vulnerable Classes and the Aspiring Middle Class

segments.src: Selain kategori miskin, BPS bersama Bank Dunia mengelompokkan penduduk ke dalam beberapa kelas berdasarkan pengeluaran, antara lain:
segments.tr: Besides the poor category, BPS, together with the World Bank, groups the population into several classes based on expenditure, including:

segments.src: - **Miskin:** di bawah garis kemiskinan.
segments.tr: - **Poor:** below the poverty line.

segments.src: - **Rentan miskin:** di atas garis kemiskinan, tetapi masih dekat dengannya sehingga mudah turun kembali.
segments.tr: - **Vulnerable to poverty:** above the poverty line, but still close to it, making it easy to fall back down.

segments.src: - **Menuju kelas menengah (aspiring middle class):** kelompok yang sudah relatif stabil, tetapi belum sepenuhnya aman dari guncangan.
segments.tr: - **Aspiring middle class:** a group that is relatively stable but not yet fully secure from shocks.

segments.src: - **Kelas menengah:** kelompok dengan pengeluaran lebih tinggi dan lebih tahan terhadap guncangan.
segments.tr: - **Middle class:** a group with higher expenditure and more resilience to shocks.

segments.src: - **Kelas atas.**
segments.tr: - **Upper class.**

segments.src: Data BPS menunjukkan bahwa porsi kelas rentan dan kelompok menuju kelas menengah jauh lebih besar daripada kelas menengah itu sendiri.
segments.tr: BPS data shows that the portion of the vulnerable class and the aspiring middle class is much larger than the middle class itself.

segments.src: Artinya, sebagian besar penduduk berada di zona yang tidak tercatat sebagai miskin, tetapi juga belum memiliki bantalan yang kuat.
segments.tr: This means that most of the population is in a zone that is not recorded as poor, but also does not yet have a strong cushion.

segments.src: Inilah kelompok yang paling sensitif terhadap perubahan harga dan pendapatan.
segments.tr: This is the group most sensitive to changes in prices and income.

segments.src: Perlu dicatat, istilah "kelas menengah" dalam statistik adalah klasifikasi berdasarkan pengeluaran, bukan penilaian gaya hidup atau status sosial.
segments.tr: It should be noted that the term "middle class" in statistics is a classification based on expenditure, not an assessment of lifestyle or social status.

segments.src: Seseorang bisa merasa "kelas menengah" karena pekerjaan kantoran, padahal secara pengeluaran dan ketahanan keuangan ia berada di kelompok rentan.
segments.tr: Someone might feel "middle class" because of an office job, even though in terms of expenditure and financial resilience, they are in a vulnerable group.

segments.src: ## Mengapa PHK dan Kenaikan Harga Pangan Memukul Lebih Keras
segments.tr: ## Why Layoffs and Rising Food Prices Hit Harder

segments.src: Dua guncangan ini bekerja dengan cara yang berbeda, tetapi sering muncul bersamaan.
segments.tr: These two shocks work in different ways but often appear together.

segments.src: **Kehilangan pekerjaan** memotong pemasukan secara mendadak.
segments.tr: **Job loss** cuts off income suddenly.

segments.src: Keluarga dengan satu pencari nafkah utama dan cicilan rutin (rumah, kendaraan, pinjaman) tidak punya banyak ruang untuk menyesuaikan.
segments.tr: Families with one main breadwinner and routine installments (housing, vehicles, loans) do not have much room to adjust.

segments.src: Tabungan biasanya habis dalam hitungan bulan, setelah itu muncul pilihan sulit: menjual aset, berutang, atau mengurangi konsumsi.
segments.tr: Savings are usually exhausted within months, after which difficult choices arise: selling assets, borrowing, or reducing consumption.

segments.src: **Kenaikan harga pangan** menggerus daya beli, terutama bagi rumah tangga yang porsi pengeluaran makanannya besar.
segments.tr: **Rising food prices** erode purchasing power, especially for households where food expenditure makes up a large portion.

segments.src: Pada kelompok berpendapatan rendah hingga menengah bawah, pangan bisa mencapai separuh lebih dari total pengeluaran.
segments.tr: In low to lower-middle-income groups, food can account for more than half of total expenditure.

segments.src: Kenaikan harga beras, minyak goreng, telur, atau cabai langsung terasa karena tidak bisa ditunda.
segments.tr: Increases in the price of rice, cooking oil, eggs, or chili are felt immediately because they cannot be postponed.

segments.src: Ketika keduanya bertemu, pengeluaran per kapita turun sementara kebutuhan tetap.
segments.tr: When both meet, per capita expenditure drops while needs remain the same.

segments.src: Keluarga yang kemarin berada sedikit di atas garis kemiskinan dapat dengan cepat bergeser mendekati atau melewatinya.
segments.tr: Families that were just above the poverty line yesterday can quickly shift to near or below it.

segments.src: Karena garis kemiskinan hanya dibaca pada titik waktu tertentu, pergeseran seperti ini baru terlihat pada rilis berikutnya, itu pun dalam bentuk angka agregat.
segments.tr: Because the poverty line is only read at a specific point in time, shifts like this are only visible in the next release, and even then, in the form of aggregate figures.

segments.src: ## Hal-Hal yang Sering Luput dari Angka Resmi
segments.tr: ## Things Often Missed by Official Figures

segments.src: - **Pekerjaan informal dan tidak stabil.** Banyak pekerja tercatat bekerja, tetapi dengan penghasilan tidak tetap dan tanpa jaminan sosial yang memadai.
segments.tr: - **Informal and unstable work.** Many workers are recorded as employed, but with irregular income and without adequate social security.

segments.src: - **Setengah pengangguran.** Orang yang bekerja kurang dari jam normal dan ingin menambah jam kerja tidak muncul sebagai "pengangguran", tetapi pendapatannya terbatas.
segments.tr: - **Underemployment.** People who work fewer than normal hours and want to increase their working hours do not appear as "unemployed," but their income is limited.

segments.src: - **Beban utang konsumtif.** Pinjaman, cicilan, dan paylater tidak tercermin dalam ukuran pengeluaran, padahal memengaruhi ruang gerak keuangan.
segments.tr: - **Consumer debt burden.** Loans, installments, and paylater services are not reflected in expenditure measures, even though they affect financial flexibility.

segments.src: - **Ketimpangan di dalam rumah tangga.** Pembagian sumber daya antaranggota keluarga tidak terlihat dalam rata-rata per kapita.
segments.tr: - **Inequality within the household.** The distribution of resources among family members is not visible in the per capita average.

segments.src: - **Biaya kesehatan dan pendidikan mendadak.** Satu kejadian sakit serius dapat menghabiskan tabungan bertahun-tahun.
segments.tr: - **Sudden health and education costs.** One serious illness event can wipe out years of savings.

segments.src: - **Perbedaan standar internasional.** Bank Dunia memakai beberapa ambang berbeda untuk negara berpendapatan menengah ke atas, dan jika ambang yang lebih tinggi dipakai, persentase penduduk yang tergolong miskin tampak jauh lebih besar. Perbedaan ini bukan soal siapa yang benar, melainkan soal definisi yang dipakai.
segments.tr: - **Differences in international standards.** The World Bank uses several different thresholds for upper-middle-income countries, and if higher thresholds are used, the percentage of the population classified as poor appears much larger. This difference is not about who is right, but about the definitions used.

segments.src: ## Cara Membaca Data Kemiskinan dengan Lebih Kritis
segments.tr: ## How to Read Poverty Data More Critically

segments.src: Beberapa langkah sederhana dapat membantu Anda menafsirkan berita dan rilis data:
segments.tr: Several simple steps can help you interpret news and data releases:

segments.src: 1. **Lihat angka absolut dan persentase sekaligus.** Persentase bisa turun tipis sementara jumlah orang tetap besar.
segments.tr: 1. **Look at absolute numbers and percentages simultaneously.** Percentages can drop slightly while the number of people remains large.

segments.src: 2. **Cek periode dan metode.** Perhatikan apakah data berasal dari Maret atau September, serta apakah ada perubahan metodologi.
segments.tr: 2. **Check the period and method.** Pay attention to whether the data comes from March or September, and whether there have been any changes in methodology.

segments.src: 3. **Bandingkan dengan indikator pendamping.** Indeks Kedalaman Kemiskinan (P1) menunjukkan seberapa jauh rata-rata pengeluaran penduduk miskin dari garis kemiskinan, sedangkan Indeks Keparahan Kemiskinan (P2) menggambarkan ketimpangan di antara penduduk miskin.
segments.tr: 3. **Compare with supporting indicators.** The Poverty Gap Index (P1) shows how far the average expenditure of the poor is from the poverty line, while the Poverty Severity Index (P2) describes inequality among the poor.

segments.src: 4. **Perhatikan rasio Gini dan data ketenagakerjaan.** Angka kemiskinan akan lebih bermakna jika dibaca bersama tingkat pengangguran terbuka, struktur pekerjaan, dan inflasi pangan.
segments.tr: 4. **Pay attention to the Gini ratio and employment data.** Poverty figures will be more meaningful if read alongside the open unemployment rate, employment structure, and food inflation.

segments.src: 5. **Pisahkan wilayah.** Bandingkan perkotaan dan perdesaan, serta provinsi, bukan hanya angka nasional.
segments.tr: 5. **Separate regions.** Compare urban and rural areas, as well as provinces, not just national figures.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Bisa Dilakukan Rumah Tangga
segments.tr: ## What Households Can Do

segments.src: Statistik adalah gambaran besar.
segments.tr: Statistics are a big picture.

segments.src: Di tingkat keluarga, beberapa langkah praktis dapat meningkatkan ketahanan:
segments.tr: At the family level, several practical steps can increase resilience:

segments.src: - **Bangun dana darurat bertahap**, meski nominalnya kecil. Target awal yang realistis adalah beberapa minggu kebutuhan pokok, lalu naik perlahan.
segments.tr: - **Build an emergency fund gradually**, even if the amount is small. A realistic initial target is a few weeks of basic needs, then increase it slowly.

segments.src: - **Kenali pengeluaran tetap dan variabel.** Dengan begitu Anda tahu bagian mana yang bisa ditekan lebih dulu saat pemasukan terganggu.
segments.tr: - **Identify fixed and variable expenses.** This way you know which parts can be cut first when income is disrupted.

segments.src: - **Hindari menambah utang konsumtif** menjelang masa tidak pasti.
segments.tr: - **Avoid increasing consumer debt** ahead of uncertain times.

segments.src: - **Pahami hak dan program yang tersedia**, seperti jaminan kesehatan, program jaminan kehilangan pekerjaan bagi peserta yang memenuhi syarat, dan bantuan sosial yang dikelola pemerintah. Informasi resmi dapat dicek melalui kanal pemerintah dan lembaga penyelenggara.
segments.tr: - **Understand rights and available programs**, such as health insurance, job loss insurance programs for eligible participants, and social assistance managed by the government. Official information can be checked through government channels and organizing institutions.

segments.src: - **Diversifikasi keterampilan dan sumber penghasilan** jika memungkinkan, agar tidak bergantung pada satu pintu pemasukan.
segments.tr: - **Diversify skills and sources of income** if possible, so as not to depend on one source of income.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Hari Pengentasan Kemiskinan Internasional adalah pengingat bahwa kemiskinan bukan sekadar angka di bawah garis tertentu.
segments.tr: The International Day for the Eradication of Poverty is a reminder that poverty is not just a number below a certain line.

segments.src: Data BPS adalah alat ukur yang berguna dan transparan metodologinya, tetapi ia dirancang untuk menjawab pertanyaan tertentu: berapa banyak penduduk yang pengeluarannya di bawah batas kebutuhan dasar.
segments.tr: BPS data is a useful tool with a transparent methodology, but it is designed to answer a specific question: how many people have expenditures below the basic needs threshold.

segments.src: Pertanyaan lain, seperti seberapa rapuh keluarga yang berada tepat di atas garis itu, perlu dibaca dari indikator tambahan dan konteks lokal.
segments.tr: Other questions, such as how fragile families just above that line are, need to be read from additional indicators and local context.

segments.src: Dengan memahami keterbatasan dan kekuatan angka resmi, pembaca dapat menilai berita ekonomi secara lebih seimbang, tanpa terjebak pada optimisme berlebihan maupun kecemasan yang tidak perlu.
segments.tr: By understanding the limitations and strengths of official figures, readers can assess economic news in a more balanced way, without getting trapped in excessive optimism or unnecessary anxiety.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat keuangan atau kebijakan.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is for general information and is not financial or policy advice.

segments.src: Untuk angka terbaru, rujuklah publikasi resmi BPS dan lembaga terkait.*
segments.tr: For the latest figures, refer to official BPS publications and related institutions.*

id-20261013-news-2.title: Controversy Over Limiting Contract Workers' Tenure to Four Years: Worker Protection or a Burden for Businesses?

segments.src: Usulan agar masa kerja karyawan kontrak dibatasi paling lama empat tahun kembali memunculkan perdebatan di ruang publik.
segments.tr: The proposal to limit the tenure of contract workers to a maximum of four years has once again sparked public debate.

segments.src: Bagi sebagian pekerja, batasan ini dipandang sebagai langkah menuju kepastian status kerja.
segments.tr: For some workers, this limit is seen as a step toward certainty in employment status.

segments.src: Bagi sebagian pelaku usaha, aturan semacam itu dikhawatirkan mengurangi fleksibilitas dalam mengatur tenaga kerja.
segments.tr: For some business actors, such rules are feared to reduce flexibility in managing the workforce.

segments.src: Artikel ini memetakan argumen kedua pihak secara berimbang agar pembaca dapat menilai persoalan ini dengan lebih utuh.
segments.tr: This article maps out the arguments of both parties in a balanced manner so that readers can evaluate this issue more comprehensively.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan bukan nasihat hukum. Usulan yang dibahas masih berupa wacana, sehingga rincian aturan dapat berubah selama proses pembahasan.
segments.tr: > **Note:** This article is informative and does not constitute legal advice. The proposal discussed is still a discourse, so the details of the rules may change during the discussion process.

segments.src: ## Latar Belakang Perdebatan
segments.tr: ## Background of the Debate

segments.src: Perjanjian kerja waktu tertentu (PKWT), atau yang lazim disebut kontrak, memang diperbolehkan dalam hukum ketenagakerjaan Indonesia.
segments.tr: Fixed-term employment agreements (PKWT), commonly referred to as contracts, are indeed permitted under Indonesian labor law.

segments.src: Skema ini umumnya digunakan untuk pekerjaan yang sifatnya sementara, musiman, atau berkaitan dengan proyek tertentu.
segments.tr: This scheme is generally used for work that is temporary, seasonal, or related to a specific project.

segments.src: Persoalan muncul ketika kontrak diperpanjang berulang kali untuk jenis pekerjaan yang sebenarnya bersifat tetap.
segments.tr: The problem arises when contracts are renewed repeatedly for types of work that are actually permanent in nature.

segments.src: Karena itu, batas maksimal masa kontrak menjadi salah satu isu yang paling sering dibicarakan dalam pembahasan regulasi ketenagakerjaan.
segments.tr: Therefore, the maximum limit of the contract period has become one of the most frequently discussed issues in labor regulation discussions.

segments.src: Gagasan pembatasan empat tahun muncul sebagai salah satu opsi di tengah upaya menata ulang aturan tersebut.
segments.tr: The idea of a four-year restriction emerged as one option amidst efforts to reorganize these rules.

segments.src: ## Argumen Serikat Pekerja
segments.tr: ## Arguments of Labor Unions

segments.src: Kalangan serikat pekerja pada umumnya menyoroti beberapa hal berikut:
segments.tr: Labor union circles generally highlight several of the following points:

segments.src: - **Kepastian status.** Pekerja yang terus-menerus berstatus kontrak kerap sulit merencanakan masa depan, termasuk dalam hal pengajuan kredit, kepemilikan rumah, dan perencanaan keluarga.
segments.tr: - **Status certainty.** Workers who continuously hold contract status often find it difficult to plan for the future, including in terms of applying for credit, home ownership, and family planning.

segments.src: - **Perlindungan hak.** Karyawan kontrak dinilai lebih rentan terhadap pemutusan hubungan kerja karena masa kontrak berakhir tanpa kewajiban yang sama seperti pekerja tetap.
segments.tr: - **Rights protection.** Contract employees are considered more vulnerable to termination because their contract period ends without the same obligations as permanent workers.

segments.src: - **Pencegahan penyalahgunaan.** Batas waktu yang tegas dianggap dapat mencegah praktik perpanjangan kontrak berulang untuk pekerjaan inti yang sebenarnya berkelanjutan.
segments.tr: - **Prevention of abuse.** A strict time limit is considered capable of preventing the practice of repeated contract extensions for core jobs that are actually ongoing.

segments.src: - **Kesetaraan manfaat.** Serikat pekerja juga mengharapkan akses yang lebih baik terhadap jenjang karier, pelatihan, dan jaminan sosial yang setara.
segments.tr: - **Equal benefits.** Labor unions also expect better access to career paths, training, and equal social security.

segments.src: ## Argumen Pelaku Usaha
segments.tr: ## Arguments of Business Actors

segments.src: Di sisi lain, asosiasi pengusaha dan sebagian pelaku usaha menyampaikan keberatan dengan alasan sebagai berikut:
segments.tr: On the other hand, employers' associations and some business actors express objections with the following reasons:

segments.src: - **Fleksibilitas operasional.** Kebutuhan tenaga kerja dapat berubah mengikuti permintaan pasar, sehingga kontrak dianggap penting untuk menjaga kelincahan bisnis.
segments.tr: - **Operational flexibility.** Workforce needs can change following market demand, so contracts are considered important to maintain business agility.

segments.src: - **Beban biaya.** Mengangkat pekerja menjadi karyawan tetap membawa konsekuensi biaya jangka panjang, termasuk kewajiban pesangon dan tunjangan.
segments.tr: - **Cost burden.** Elevating workers to permanent employees carries long-term cost consequences, including severance pay and allowance obligations.

segments.src: - **Risiko bagi usaha kecil.** Perusahaan skala kecil dan menengah dikhawatirkan lebih sulit menyesuaikan diri dengan batasan yang kaku.
segments.tr: - **Risks for small businesses.** Small and medium-scale companies are feared to have a harder time adapting to rigid restrictions.

segments.src: - **Dampak pada perekrutan.** Sebagian pengusaha khawatir perusahaan akan lebih berhati-hati membuka lowongan baru atau memilih tidak memperpanjang kontrak menjelang batas waktu.
segments.tr: - **Impact on recruitment.** Some employers worry companies will be more cautious in opening new vacancies or choose not to renew contracts near the deadline.

segments.src: ## Kemungkinan Dampak bagi Pekerja
segments.tr: ## Potential Impacts for Workers

segments.src: Dampak kebijakan ini sangat bergantung pada rumusan akhirnya.
segments.tr: The impact of this policy heavily depends on its final formulation.

segments.src: Secara umum, ada beberapa skenario yang kerap dibahas:
segments.tr: Generally, there are several scenarios frequently discussed:

segments.src: 1. **Pekerja diangkat menjadi tetap.** Perusahaan yang membutuhkan tenaga kerja berkelanjutan dapat memilih mengangkat karyawan setelah masa kontrak berakhir.
segments.tr: 1. **Workers are appointed as permanent.** Companies that need ongoing labor may choose to hire employees after the contract period ends.

segments.src: 2. **Kontrak tidak diperpanjang.** Perusahaan dapat memilih merekrut orang baru untuk posisi yang sama, sehingga pekerja lama kehilangan kesempatan.
segments.tr: 2. **Contracts are not renewed.** Companies may choose to recruit new people for the same position, causing old workers to lose the opportunity.

segments.src: 3. **Pergeseran skema kerja.** Sebagian perusahaan mungkin beralih ke model lain, seperti alih daya atau kemitraan, sehingga perlu pengawasan agar perlindungan pekerja tetap terjaga.
segments.tr: 3. **Shift in work schemes.** Some companies might switch to other models, such as outsourcing or partnerships, so supervision is needed to ensure worker protection is maintained.

segments.src: Pengalaman di berbagai negara menunjukkan bahwa hasil kebijakan serupa tidak selalu seragam.
segments.tr: Experience in various countries shows that the results of similar policies are not always uniform.

segments.src: Efeknya dipengaruhi oleh kondisi ekonomi, sektor industri, serta kuat-lemahnya pengawasan di lapangan.
segments.tr: The effect is influenced by economic conditions, industry sectors, and the strength or weakness of enforcement in the field.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi Perekrutan dan Dunia Usaha
segments.tr: ## Impact on Recruitment and the Business World

segments.src: Dari sisi perekrutan, aturan yang lebih ketat dapat mendorong perusahaan menyusun perencanaan tenaga kerja yang lebih matang.
segments.tr: From the recruitment side, stricter rules can push companies to draft more mature workforce planning.

segments.src: Namun, jika dirasa terlalu membebani, perusahaan bisa menunda ekspansi atau mengurangi jumlah rekrutmen, terutama pada masa ketidakpastian ekonomi.
segments.tr: However, if it is felt to be too burdensome, companies could delay expansion or reduce the amount of recruitment, especially during times of economic uncertainty.

segments.src: Karena itu, banyak pengamat menyarankan agar pembatasan masa kontrak disertai langkah pendukung, misalnya:
segments.tr: Therefore, many observers suggest that contract term limits be accompanied by supporting steps, for example:

segments.src: - pengecualian atau pengaturan khusus bagi pekerjaan berbasis proyek dan musiman;
segments.tr: - exceptions or special arrangements for project-based and seasonal work;

segments.src: - insentif bagi usaha kecil dan menengah yang mengangkat pekerja tetap;
segments.tr: - incentives for small and medium enterprises that hire permanent workers;

segments.src: - pelatihan keterampilan agar pekerja lebih siap berpindah antarsektor;
segments.tr: - skills training so workers are more prepared to move between sectors;

segments.src: - pengawasan yang konsisten agar aturan tidak mudah dihindari.
segments.tr: - consistent supervision so the rules are not easily evaded.

segments.src: ## Mencari Titik Temu
segments.tr: ## Finding Common Ground

segments.src: Perdebatan ini pada dasarnya menyangkut dua kepentingan yang sama-sama sah: kepastian dan perlindungan bagi pekerja, serta keberlangsungan dan daya saing dunia usaha.
segments.tr: This debate essentially concerns two equally valid interests: certainty and protection for workers, and the sustainability and competitiveness of the business world.

segments.src: Kedua kepentingan tersebut tidak harus saling meniadakan.
segments.tr: Both interests do not have to negate each other.

segments.src: Dialog tripartit yang melibatkan pemerintah, pengusaha, dan serikat pekerja, disertai data yang transparan, menjadi kunci agar kebijakan yang dihasilkan dapat diterima dan dijalankan secara efektif.
segments.tr: Tripartite dialogue involving the government, employers, and labor unions, accompanied by transparent data, is the key so that the resulting policy can be accepted and implemented effectively.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Usulan pembatasan masa kerja karyawan kontrak menjadi empat tahun menunjukkan bahwa penataan hubungan kerja masih menjadi pekerjaan rumah yang penting.
segments.tr: The proposal to limit contract workers' tenure to four years shows that organizing employment relationships remains an important homework assignment.

segments.src: Apa pun hasil akhirnya, kebijakan yang baik perlu memperhatikan kebutuhan pekerja akan kepastian sekaligus kebutuhan dunia usaha akan kelenturan.
segments.tr: Whatever the final outcome, a good policy needs to pay attention to workers' needs for certainty as well as the business world's need for flexibility.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan mengikuti perkembangan pembahasan dari sumber resmi dan media tepercaya.
segments.tr: Readers are advised to follow the developments of the discussion from official sources and trusted media.

id-20261013-intro-logistics-10.title: [Logistics #10] The Same Coffee, Two Different Roads: Why Prices at Stalls and on Marketplaces Are Never the Same?

segments.src: > Saluran distribusi menentukan **siapa** yang memegang barang sampai ke tangan Anda; logistik menentukan **bagaimana** barang itu bergerak — dan gudang, pusat distribusi, serta pusat fulfillment adalah tempat keduanya bertemu.
segments.tr: > The distribution channel determines **who** holds the goods until they reach your hands; logistics determines **how** the goods move — and warehouses, distribution centers, and fulfillment centers are where the two meet.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Setiap barang yang Anda pegang hari ini pernah melewati dua hal sekaligus: **perpindahan kepemilikan** dan **perpindahan fisik**.
segments.tr: Every product you hold today has gone through two things at once: **a transfer of ownership** and **a physical transfer**.

segments.src: Dua hal ini sering dikira sama, padahal berbeda.
segments.tr: These two are often thought to be the same, but they are different.

segments.src: **Saluran distribusi (distribution channel)** adalah rangkaian pihak yang membuat produk berpindah kepemilikan dari produsen ke konsumen.
segments.tr: A **distribution channel** is the chain of parties that moves a product's ownership from the producer to the consumer.

segments.src: Biasanya digambarkan berdasarkan jumlah perantara:
segments.tr: It is usually described by the number of intermediaries:

segments.src: Level 0 : Produsen -> Konsumen                              (D2C, pabrik jual langsung)
segments.tr: Level 0 : Produsen -> Konsumen                              (D2C, pabrik jual langsung)

segments.src: Level 1 : Produsen -> Pengecer -> Konsumen                  (minimarket, ritel modern)
segments.tr: Level 1 : Produsen -> Pengecer -> Konsumen                  (minimarket, ritel modern)

segments.src: Level 2 : Produsen -> Distributor -> Pengecer -> Konsumen
segments.tr: Level 2 : Produsen -> Distributor -> Pengecer -> Konsumen

segments.src: Level 3 : Produsen -> Distributor -> Grosir -> Warung -> Konsumen
segments.tr: Level 3 : Produsen -> Distributor -> Grosir -> Warung -> Konsumen

segments.src: Semakin panjang salurannya, semakin luas jangkauannya — tetapi semakin banyak pula margin yang menumpuk di harga akhir.
segments.tr: The longer the channel, the wider its reach — but also the more margin piles up in the final price.

segments.src: Inilah alasan struktural kenapa satu produk yang sama bisa punya harga berbeda di dua tempat.
segments.tr: This is the structural reason why the same product can have different prices in two places.

segments.src: Saluran distribusi menjalankan tiga jenis fungsi: **fungsi transaksi** (membeli, menjual, menanggung risiko barang tidak laku), **fungsi logistik** (menyimpan, mengangkut, memecah muatan besar jadi kecil), dan **fungsi fasilitasi** (pembiayaan, informasi pasar, layanan purnajual).
segments.tr: A distribution channel performs three kinds of functions: **transaction functions** (buying, selling, bearing the risk of unsold goods), **logistics functions** (storing, transporting, and breaking large shipments into smaller ones), and **facilitating functions** (financing, market information, after-sales service).

segments.src: Ketika sebuah perusahaan memotong perantara — misalnya brand yang tadinya lewat distributor lalu membuka toko sendiri di marketplace — ketiga fungsi itu tidak hilang.
segments.tr: When a company cuts out intermediaries — for example, a brand that used to go through a distributor but opens its own store on a marketplace — none of those three functions disappear.

segments.src: Fungsi itu hanya **pindah pundak**.
segments.tr: They simply **shift shoulders**.

segments.src: Brand tersebut kini harus menyimpan sendiri, mengirim sendiri, dan menanggung sendiri risiko stok mati.
segments.tr: The brand must now store, ship, and bear the risk of dead stock on its own.

segments.src: Ini yang disebut **disintermediasi**: memotong perantara berarti mengambil alih pekerjaannya, bukan menghapus pekerjaannya.
segments.tr: This is what is called **disintermediation**: cutting out an intermediary means taking over its work, not eliminating it.

segments.src: Di sisi fisik, ada tiga jenis fasilitas yang sering disamakan padahal fungsinya berbeda:
segments.tr: On the physical side, there are three types of facilities that are often confused even though their functions differ:

segments.src: | Fasilitas | Tujuan utama | Satuan keluar | Ciri khas |
segments.tr: | Facility | Main purpose | Outbound unit | Distinctive trait |

segments.src: | **Gudang (warehouse)** | Menyimpan | Palet | Barang menginap lama, fokus kapasitas |
segments.tr: | **Warehouse** | Storing | Pallet | Goods stay for a long time, focus on capacity |

segments.src: | **Pusat distribusi (DC)** | Mengalirkan | Karton | Barang cepat keluar, fokus kecepatan putar |
segments.tr: | **Distribution center (DC)** | Flowing | Carton | Goods move out quickly, focus on inventory turnover speed |

segments.src: | **Pusat fulfillment** | Melayani pesanan eceran | Satuan (pcs) | Ribuan pesanan kecil per hari, per nama pembeli |
segments.tr: | **Fulfillment center** | Serving retail orders | Unit (pcs) | Thousands of small orders per day, per buyer |

segments.src: **Pusat distribusi** melayani *toko*: ia menerima truk besar dari banyak pabrik, lalu mengirim ulang campuran barang ke tiap cabang ritel.
segments.tr: A **distribution center** serves *stores*: it receives large trucks from many factories, then re-ships mixed goods to each retail branch.

segments.src: Bentuk paling ekstremnya adalah **cross-docking** — barang masuk lewat pintu belakang truk dan langsung naik ke truk lain dalam hitungan jam, hampir tanpa disimpan.
segments.tr: Its most extreme form is **cross-docking** — goods come in through the back of a truck and immediately go onto another truck within hours, almost without being stored.

segments.src: **Pusat fulfillment** melayani *individu*.
segments.tr: A **fulfillment center** serves *individuals*.

segments.src: Alurnya adalah **pick–pack–ship**: petugas mengambil satu-dua item dari rak, mengemasnya, menempel label, lalu menyerahkan ke kurir.
segments.tr: The flow is **pick–pack–ship**: staff pick one or two items from shelves, pack them, attach a label, and hand them to the courier.

segments.src: Karena satu pesanan bisa berisi satu botol sabun seharga Rp 25.000, biaya per pesanan menjadi variabel paling menentukan untung-rugi.
segments.tr: Since a single order might contain one bottle of soap worth Rp 25,000, the cost per order becomes the most decisive variable for profit or loss.

segments.src: Di sinilah muncul jasa **3PL** (*third-party logistics*) — pihak ketiga yang menyewakan gudang, tenaga, dan pengiriman, sehingga penjual kecil tidak perlu membangun gudang sendiri.
segments.tr: This is where **3PL** (*third-party logistics*) services come in — third parties who rent out warehouses, labor, and shipping, so small sellers don't need to build their own warehouses.

segments.src: Satu istilah terakhir: **ongkos last mile**, yaitu biaya perjalanan terakhir dari titik distribusi ke pintu rumah pembeli.
segments.tr: One last term: **last-mile cost**, meaning the cost of the final leg from the distribution point to the buyer's front door.

segments.src: Jaraknya paling pendek, tetapi porsinya sering menjadi komponen biaya pengiriman yang paling besar, karena satu kurir hanya membawa sedikit paket per perhentian.
segments.tr: It is the shortest distance, yet its share is often the largest component of shipping cost, because a single courier carries only a few parcels per stop.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Bayangkan sebungkus kopi bubuk merek lokal, 200 gram, diproduksi di Semarang.
segments.tr: Imagine a 200-gram pack of local-brand ground coffee, produced in Semarang.

segments.src: Merek ini menjual lewat **dua jalur sekaligus**.
segments.tr: This brand sells through **two channels at once**.

segments.src: **Jalur pertama (tradisional, Level 3).** Dari pabrik, kopi dikirim satu truk penuh ke gudang distributor di Bekasi.
segments.tr: **First channel (traditional, Level 3).** From the factory, the coffee is shipped by a full truck to a distributor's warehouse in Bekasi.

segments.src: Distributor memecahnya menjadi karton, menjualnya ke grosir di Pasar Kramat Jati, lalu grosir menjualnya per lusin ke warung-warung di gang perumahan.
segments.tr: The distributor breaks it into cartons and sells them to a wholesaler at Kramat Jati Market, and the wholesaler sells them by the dozen to stalls in residential alleys.

segments.src: Ongkos kirim per bungkus sangat murah — karena satu truk membawa ribuan bungkus sekaligus — tetapi ada tiga pihak yang masing-masing mengambil margin.
segments.tr: The shipping cost per pack is very low — because one truck carries thousands of packs at once — but three parties each take a margin.

segments.src: Harga di warung, misalnya, menjadi Rp 18.000.
segments.tr: The price at the stall, for example, becomes Rp 18,000.

segments.src: Keunggulannya: pembeli bisa mengambilnya jam 10 malam dengan berjalan kaki 50 meter, dan tidak membayar ongkir sepeser pun.
segments.tr: The advantage: a buyer can get it at 10 p.m. by walking 50 meters, and pays not a single rupiah in shipping.

segments.src: **Jalur kedua (online, Level 0/1).** Merek yang sama menitipkan stok ke pusat fulfillment di kawasan Cakung.
segments.tr: **Second channel (online, Level 0/1).** The same brand consigns stock to a fulfillment center in the Cakung area.

segments.src: Saat ada pesanan dari Bandung, petugas mengambil satu bungkus dari rak, mengemas, dan menyerahkannya ke kurir.
segments.tr: When an order comes from Bandung, staff take one pack from the shelf, pack it, and hand it to the courier.

segments.src: Harga produknya bisa lebih murah, misalnya Rp 15.000 — karena tidak ada distributor dan grosir.
segments.tr: The product price can be cheaper, for example Rp 15,000 — because there are no distributors or wholesalers.

segments.src: Tetapi muncul biaya baru: ongkir satu kilogram Jakarta–Bandung, misalnya sekitar Rp 12.000–15.000, ditambah biaya penanganan per pesanan di gudang.
segments.tr: But a new cost appears: shipping for one kilogram from Jakarta to Bandung, for example around Rp 12,000–15,000, plus the warehouse handling fee per order.

segments.src: Ekonominya baru masuk akal kalau pembeli membeli **lima bungkus sekaligus** — karena ongkirnya nyaris sama untuk satu atau lima bungkus.
segments.tr: The economics only make sense if the buyer purchases **five packs at once** — because the shipping cost is nearly the same for one pack or five.

segments.src: Dari sini muncul dua pelajaran yang sangat khas Indonesia:
segments.tr: Two lessons that are very typically Indonesian emerge from this:

segments.src: Pertama, **promo "gratis ongkir" bukan sihir**.
segments.tr: First, **"free shipping" promos are not magic**.

segments.src: Ia adalah subsidi yang dibayar salah satu pihak — marketplace, brand, atau keduanya — untuk menutup biaya last mile.
segments.tr: They are subsidies paid by one of the parties — the marketplace, the brand, or both — to cover last-mile costs.

segments.src: Ketika subsidi itu dikurangi, perilaku belanja ikut berubah drastis.
segments.tr: When that subsidy is reduced, shopping behavior changes drastically.

segments.src: Kedua, **konflik saluran (channel conflict)** itu nyata.
segments.tr: Second, **channel conflict** is real.

segments.src: Kalau harga online merek tersebut terlalu murah, pemilik warung dan grosir merasa dirugikan dan bisa berhenti menyetok.
segments.tr: If the brand's online price is too cheap, owners of stalls and wholesalers feel harmed and may stop stocking the product.

segments.src: Padahal jaringan warung dan minimarket masih menjangkau pelosok yang tidak ekonomis dilayani kurir satuan.
segments.tr: Yet networks of stalls and minimarkets still reach remote areas that are uneconomical to serve with individual couriers.

segments.src: Karena itu banyak brand di Indonesia sengaja menjaga harga online tetap setara atau sedikit lebih tinggi, dan membedakan produknya lewat ukuran kemasan atau paket bundling — bukan lewat perang harga.
segments.tr: That is why many brands in Indonesia deliberately keep online prices equal or slightly higher, and differentiate their products through package sizes or bundle packages — rather than through price wars.

segments.src: Ketiga, geografi menentukan segalanya.
segments.tr: Third, geography determines everything.

segments.src: Barang yang sama bisa sampai besok pagi di Jabodetabek karena ada pusat fulfillment di dekatnya, tetapi butuh berhari-hari ke kota lain yang harus dilayani lewat penerbangan atau kapal.
segments.tr: The same goods can arrive the next morning in Greater Jakarta because there is a fulfillment center nearby, but take days to reach other cities that must be served by air or sea.

segments.src: Solusinya bukan mempercepat kurir, melainkan **memindahkan stok lebih dekat ke pembeli** — misalnya membuka gudang regional di Surabaya atau Makassar.
segments.tr: The solution is not to speed up couriers, but to **move stock closer to the buyer** — for example, by opening regional warehouses in Surabaya or Makassar.

segments.src: Itulah keputusan strategis paling mahal sekaligus paling menentukan dalam desain jaringan distribusi.
segments.tr: That is the most expensive yet most decisive strategic decision in designing a distribution network.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Saluran distribusi mengurus perpindahan **kepemilikan**, logistik mengurus perpindahan **fisik**; memotong perantara tidak menghapus pekerjaannya, hanya memindahkannya ke pundak lain.
segments.tr: 1. Distribution channels handle the transfer of **ownership**, logistics handles the physical transfer; cutting out intermediaries does not eliminate their work, it only moves it to other shoulders.

segments.src: 2. Gudang menyimpan, pusat distribusi mengalirkan barang ke **toko** dalam satuan karton, pusat fulfillment melayani **pesanan individu** dalam satuan pcs lewat alur pick–pack–ship.
segments.tr: 2. Warehouses store, distribution centers flow goods to **stores** in cartons, and fulfillment centers serve **individual orders** in pcs through the pick–pack–ship flow.

segments.src: 3. Biaya last mile dan konflik saluran adalah dua hal yang membuat harga online dan offline sulit disamakan — dan alasan kenapa lokasi gudang, bukan kecepatan kurir, sering jadi penentu utama kecepatan pengiriman.
segments.tr: 3. Last-mile costs and channel conflict are two things that make online and offline prices hard to equalize — and the reason why warehouse location, rather than courier speed, often becomes the main determinant of delivery speed.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Sebuah fasilitas menerima barang dari 12 pabrik pada pagi hari, menyortirnya, dan mengirimkannya ke 40 cabang minimarket pada sore hari yang sama tanpa menyimpannya di rak.
segments.tr: **1.** A facility receives goods from 12 factories in the morning, sorts them, and ships them to 40 minimarket branches the same afternoon without storing them on shelves.

segments.src: Praktik ini paling tepat disebut:
segments.tr: This practice is most accurately called:

segments.src: - (A) Fulfillment
segments.tr: - (A) Fulfillment

segments.src: - (B) Cross-docking
segments.tr: - (B) Cross-docking

segments.src: - (C) Disintermediasi
segments.tr: - (C) Disintermediation

segments.src: - (D) Konflik saluran
segments.tr: - (D) Channel conflict

segments.src: **2.** Sebuah brand memutuskan berhenti memakai distributor dan menjual langsung ke konsumen lewat marketplace.
segments.tr: **2.** A brand decides to stop using distributors and sell directly to consumers through a marketplace.

segments.src: Pernyataan yang paling tepat adalah:
segments.tr: The most accurate statement is:

segments.src: - (A) Fungsi penyimpanan dan penanggungan risiko stok ikut hilang
segments.tr: - (A) The storage function and stock risk-bearing function disappear too

segments.src: - (B) Fungsi tersebut tetap ada, tetapi kini ditanggung sendiri oleh brand
segments.tr: - (B) The function remains, but is now borne by the brand itself

segments.src: - (C) Biaya logistik per unit pasti turun karena tidak ada perantara
segments.tr: - (C) The logistics cost per unit definitely drops because there are no intermediaries

segments.src: - (D) Brand otomatis menjangkau lebih banyak konsumen di daerah terpencil
segments.tr: - (D) The brand automatically reaches more consumers in remote areas

segments.src: **3.** (O/X) Ongkos last mile disebut mahal karena jaraknya paling jauh dibanding tahap pengiriman lainnya.
segments.tr: **3.** (O/X) Last-mile cost is said to be expensive because its distance is the longest compared to other shipping stages.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Saluran distribusi (distribution channel):** Rangkaian pihak yang memindahkan kepemilikan produk dari produsen sampai ke konsumen akhir.
segments.tr: - **Distribution channel:** The chain of parties that transfers product ownership from the producer to the final consumer.

segments.src: - **Pusat distribusi (DC):** Fasilitas yang tugas utamanya mengalirkan barang secepat mungkin ke jaringan toko, bukan menyimpannya lama.
segments.tr: - **Distribution center (DC):** A facility whose main task is to flow goods into the store network as fast as possible, rather than storing them for long.

segments.src: - **Pusat fulfillment:** Fasilitas yang memproses pesanan eceran per individu dengan alur pick–pack–ship.
segments.tr: - **Fulfillment center:** A facility that processes retail orders per individual with a pick–pack–ship flow.

segments.src: - **Cross-docking:** Praktik memindahkan barang dari truk masuk langsung ke truk keluar dengan waktu simpan mendekati nol.
segments.tr: - **Cross-docking:** The practice of moving goods from an incoming truck directly to an outgoing truck with near-zero storage time.

segments.src: - **3PL (third-party logistics):** Penyedia jasa logistik pihak ketiga yang menangani pergudangan dan pengiriman atas nama penjual.
segments.tr: - **3PL (third-party logistics):** A third-party logistics provider that handles warehousing and shipping on behalf of the seller.

segments.src: - **Konflik saluran (channel conflict):** Benturan kepentingan antar-jalur penjualan, misalnya harga online yang merugikan pengecer tradisional.
segments.tr: - **Channel conflict:** A clash of interests between sales channels, for example online prices that harm traditional retailers.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1 — (B).
segments.tr: *Answers: 1 — (B).

segments.src: Barang masuk dan keluar pada hari yang sama tanpa disimpan di rak adalah ciri khas cross-docking; fulfillment melayani pesanan per individu, bukan pengiriman antar-toko.
segments.tr: Goods coming in and going out on the same day without being stored on shelves is the hallmark of cross-docking; fulfillment serves individual orders, not store-to-store shipments.

segments.src: Disintermediasi memindahkan fungsi transaksi, logistik, dan fasilitasi ke pundak brand, tidak menghapusnya; biaya per unit bahkan bisa naik karena pengiriman jadi satuan.
segments.tr: Disintermediation moves the transaction, logistics, and facilitating functions onto the brand's shoulders; it does not eliminate them; the cost per unit can even rise because shipments become unit-based.

segments.tr: 3 — X (false).

segments.src: Justru jaraknya paling pendek.
segments.tr: Actually it is the shortest distance.

segments.tr: Its cost is high because a single courier delivers only a few parcels per stop, so the cost per parcel is large.*
